description: Configure, operate, and master KEDA (Kubernetes Event-driven Autoscaling) — ScaledObject, ScaledJob, TriggerAuthentication CRDs, 70+ scalers, HPA behavior tuning, scale-to-zero, the KEDA HTTP Add-on, production hardening, multi-trigger semantics, scalingModifiers formulas, GitOps integration, and troubleshooting stuck scalers.
